checks.name: Actual getRun ownership shape
checks.result: getRun strips template/leaseToken and omits owner_id. Payload preserves scope/objectId/taskId/executor/workspace/native. Missing ownerId is rechecked by the existing owner-filtered runsForTask index; optional ownerId mismatch still rejects. Saved real Factory receipts were also locally inspected for this exact shape.

checks.name: Identity/revision/goal/native boundary
checks.result: Requires same owner task/project/scope/machine/executor/workspace and supervisor identity; positive expected task revision may not exceed the frozen current task revision. Traverses only consumedRunId with exact predecessor resultHash. Changed goal is a verified exclusion boundary; old-goal originals are not imported. New-native handoff requires the existing bound signed stop identity/proof and excludes the predecessor native rather than mixing its originals.

checks.name: Missing current originals cannot be filled by history
checks.result: Each declared source reference is resolved by the unchanged receipt verifier. Same path/differentH rejects; same path/H deduplicates bytes while retaining each source binding. A missing current receipt remains missing/current=true and complete=false even when predecessor bytes match.

checks.name: Frozen input and authorization
checks.result: Fresh binding/history SHA and exact originals/table/citation whitelist are rechecked before model, before applying judgment and before successor dispatch. Pause/revision/context/policy/task/receipt changes fail closed. This does not create new authorization requirements or change existing owner authorization.

checks.name: Single consumption and retry boundary
checks.result: Original consumed-run guard/table insertion and deterministic model intent remain. Already consumed/uncertain models are not automatically invoked again. New history is frozen only into newly prepared inputs; old intents/signed feedback are not rewritten.

checks.name: Complete prompt limit
checks.result: 131072 UTF8 bytes still applies to the entire contract+separator+serialized projected input including continuity metadata and every retained original. Helper additionally has explicit20run/120unique/256KiB decoded bounds; it rejects instead of truncating. Strict model adapter, partial rejection and per-run receipt/private-content gates are unchanged.

checks.name: Root contract distinction
checks.result: Explicitly evaluates only supplied criteria and existing bound authorization. Trusted server transport identifies the run carrying historical bytes; it does not fabricate historical producer aliases/signatures. A document author being unable to sign does not negate the agent transport binding. No criteria or acceptance standard is weakened.

validation.source: Root actual112 saved stdout/stderr; read locally, never rerun here
validation.independentSourceOfExitCodes: Root reports targeted/types/build all exit0. Raw saved stdout/stderr alone do not encode the process exit code.
